unavailable: Managing API tokens requires the admin role.
signInPrompt: Sign in as an admin to manage API tokens.

owner.label: Owner
owner.info: A token acts as its owner. Disabling or deleting the owner stops the token, and its role is capped at the owner's.

no-owner.info: The account that owned this token is gone, so it no longer authenticates. Revoke it to tidy the list.

owner-disabled.info: The owning account is disabled, so it no longer authenticates.

ssoIdle.info: Yagra is not told when an identity provider disables an account. An SSO-owned token stops once its owner has been absent too long.

token.title: Token created
token.intro: Copy this token now — it is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
token.label: API token

revoke.title: Revoke token
revoke.confirm: Revoke the token "{{name}}"? Any client using it loses access immediately.

err.duplicate: A token with that name already exists
err.noSurface: Choose at least one surface the token can be used for
